name: lamport-warden
description: Lamport Warden browser extension: reads each Solana signing request before your wallet does, says what it will do, and stops it when that is not what you meant.

scripts.test:browser: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-fixtures.mjs && node scripts/build-web.mjs && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts
scripts.test:wallets: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-fixtures.mjs && vitest run --config vitest.wallets.config.ts
scripts.shots: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-fixtures.mjs && WARDEN_SHOTS=1 vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts
